name: rq6-weight-dev
description:
RQ6, the weight of the recall-weighted loss on development data: weights 3, 5 and 10,
three seeds each, against cross-entropy and focal loss (the best loss so far,
rq6-loss-dev). Weight 3 is also compared with cross-entropy at 0.125, its matching
threshold. The matching thresholds of weights 5 and 10 (0.08, 0.04) lie below the
prediction cache's floor (systems.CACHE_FLOOR = 0.1), so that control waits until a
weight beats cross-entropy at all. Weight 5's first seed was trained on a
CPU (karol), every other model on the Mac GPU.
